_readme: Verbatim transcription of PIN-SLAM T-RO 2024 (arXiv 2401.09101v2) Table IV, page 11 of sources/2401.09101v2_pin_slam.pdf (sha256 adbb1b9eab69aa4ba338b2ba52214532675d037cf9808deb6068470d9c92950c). Metric: ATE RMSE [m] after Umeyama SE(3) trajectory alignment, motion-compensated point clouds, printed at decimeter precision. '*' = sequence with loops; Avg.* = average on loop sequences; Avg. = average column as printed. 'offline_pgo' flags methods marked ‡ (offline pose graph optimization). PIN-LO/PIN-SLAM rows are means over 10 random-seed runs (std omitted here). Transcribed 2026-09-19; independent re-extraction check in validate_horizontal_comparison.py.
source: PIN-SLAM T-RO 2024 preprint, Table IV, page 11
known_transcription_notes: Naive 11-sequence mean of the printed Litamin2 row is 2.64, but the printed Avg. is 2.4; the naive mean of SC-LeGO-LOAM is 3.87, but the printed Avg. is 5.3. All other rows match naive means at decimeter rounding. The caption does not define the plain Avg. column beyond Avg.*; printed values are kept verbatim and the inconsistency is reported, not corrected.
Third-party surveys transcribe the arXiv v1 of this table (e.g. PIN-SLAM seq 02 = 3.3); the archived T-RO v2 PDF prints 2.1. This file follows the archived T-RO version only.
